kind: Bounded read-only Windows census substitution assessment
verdict: No existing bounded equivalent native substitution established; no producer, R1 or new architecture selected.

review.conclusion: No existing bounded native process/listener census substitution is established in the reviewed current call chain.

existingBackend.entry: nativeWindowsAppGate.mjs assertOwnedRenderer -> observeCensus -> windowsProcessListenerSnapshot -> one powershell execFileSync -> ordered CIM process query then TCP listener owner query -> both parsers -> validateCensus -> listener membership -> remaining
existingBackend.freshness: Every existing call is fresh; the combined result is ordered, not atomic.
existingBackend.requiredCoverage: Complete process census, original controller/driver/Main identity and ancestry/orphan coverage, plus every CDP listener PID joined to retained original birth/lineage.

nativeAlternatives.coverage: One already captured PID+birth HANDLE; at most four Q observations followed by W; no parent/executable census or listener ownership.

Still PowerShell/CIM; returns pid/ppid/command, omits birth and listener table. Default TTL/in-flight sharing disallowed for this authority; bypassCache restores fresh querying but not the missing schema or backend change.

measuredPackagedX64.limit: Full helper duration only; no separate PowerShell startup/CIM/TCP/parsing cost; original post-read cutoff refusal preserved.

process15s.predicate: runtime.read -> projected nativeReady === true, with original pre/post-await deadline checks
process15s.limit: The retained ARM Codex and x64 OpenCode failures are distinct readiness/currentness boundaries. No common PowerShell/CIM cause or benefit from substituting the packaged census is demonstrated.

minimumDiagnostic.alreadyAvailable: Existing bounded censusReads establishes x64 whole-call cost. Retain its closed summary in the existing <=8192-byte failure output to avoid losing ARM data when no final receipt is written; no additional query or clock is needed for that retention.
minimumDiagnostic.ifInternalCostMustBeResolved: A separate explicit scope would need monotonic timing around the two unchanged queries within the one existing PowerShell invocation, and separate bounded Node-side parsing time if required. Preserve exact queries, ordering, returned authority, per-call sample count and deadlines. The outer-minus-inner residual includes startup/serialization/transfer/teardown; it is not a pure startup measurement.

invariants: No cached authority or returned-result reuse

preciseLimits: The conclusion is bounded to the inspected existing call chain and closed native wire surface; it is not a claim that Windows provides no other APIs.
The packaged helper already combines the two original queries into one fresh PowerShell invocation. No second startup can simply be removed from that owner observation.
Retained HANDLE/Job observations cannot replace full process discovery, parent/birth lineage and foreign TCP listener coverage.
The product process-table helper is only an examined alternative, not the exact packaged gate call site. Its default TTL/in-flight reuse is not eligible here.
Original Packaged x64 census durations cover startup, ordered queries and parsing together. No internal component is assigned the total cost as a proven cause.
The last-read offsets are relative to the retained phase marker, not a newly recorded authoritative cutoff.
ARM has no retained final same-Main receipt; no x64 timing result transfers to ARM.
No common CIM cause is established for Process15s and Packaged10s. Attached is not nativeReady.
Possible timing instrumentation is only a scope boundary for a separately reviewed proposal. This review authors or selects no such proposal.
No shell, native invocation, test, source/R1/workflow postimage, CI query, ref/PR mutation, retry or timer change occurred.
